name: 51degrees/fiftyone.pipeline.did
description: Strongly typed reader for the 51Did (51Degrees Identifier) value returned by the 51Degrees Cloud service, and a client for the cloud's 51Did endpoints (public keys, signature verification and creator context redemption). Parses the OWID envelope and exposes the Flags, License Id and value (Hash) plus the identifier type. Compare values, never envelopes.

repositories.comment: Consume the 51Degrees fork of owid-php from the local git submodule. Switch to Packagist once owid-php is published upstream.
